history_summary.value: The Ohiki is a Japanese true bantam from Kochi Prefecture, thought to have arisen during the Edo period from crossing long-tailed breeds such as the Onagadori with small bantams such as the Chabo. It was declared a Natural Monument of Japan in 1923 and was not bred in Britain until the 1990s.
